content: Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao sanidi
Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao site tuwelo ꞌibwauwediya ma loina ma waiwai ꞌiꞌebwaediya ma ꞌoinega sawasawahidi hiꞌahiꞌa tomota ꞌoidiyega siulalatuhedi ma lohala ma weꞌa ꞌoidiyega tomota siꞌabihe bwebweꞌanedi.
Cana tomuliyaowedi sanidiyao bewa: Nugeta Saimoni, tauna sihesaniyeya Pita, ma tasina Andulu, wete Yemesa ma tasina Yoni, taudi tamadiu Sebedi,
wete Pilipi ma Batolomiu ma Tomasi ma Madiu, tauna takesi ꞌana toꞌewa, ma wete hali Yemesa tauna Alipiyo natuna, ma Tadiyasi,
ma wete hali Saimoni, tauna toꞌalaꞌoheꞌohe Isileli ꞌina miyawasi Loma weyahina, ma Yudasa Isakaliyota, tauna ꞌabwa Yesu ꞌitebae.
Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌidi paihowao
Yesu site tuwelowedi ꞌiloinediya ma ꞌihesumanediya, ꞌigwae, “Sahena taudi ganamuli ꞌoidiya watautauya, ma wete sahena Sameliya ꞌasanao ꞌoidiya waluhuluhu,
ma hesi sipi ꞌwaniꞌwanidi ꞌoidiya watauya, taudi beno ꞌida bodao meIsileli,
ma ꞌoidiya wahepwaila ꞌabehega Yehoba ꞌina loina ꞌilatu pwaima.

Tolohalao waꞌabihe yawesaidi ma toꞌamasa waꞌabihe toholodi ma tolepelowao waꞌabihe bwebweꞌanedi, ma wete hiꞌahiꞌa tomota ꞌoidiyega waulalatuhedi. Yehoba ꞌina helau ꞌiꞌebwae daisigomi pwaiya, ꞌoinega ꞌomi wete sawasawahimi ma waꞌebwaya ꞌawawa tomota ꞌoidiya.
“Ma ꞌimi sakowasi ꞌoina sahena mane ꞌimi peha ꞌoidiya wadoꞌodoꞌo, haite weyahina.
Sahena wete peha waꞌewaꞌewa, sahena wete ꞌami ꞌaleꞌo ꞌeluwa, sahena ꞌami butu ꞌeluwa, sahena ꞌimi digona ꞌeluwa waꞌewaꞌewadi, ma hesi ꞌabwa ꞌami ꞌiluwana waloba, ꞌabwa waꞌai.
“Ma ꞌeguma ꞌasa madouna bo ꞌiꞌiuna ꞌoina waluhu waꞌebesa nugeta taiya ꞌina mumuga ꞌausalana, ma ꞌoina wahetaumana ee ꞌana siga tupwaina waꞌebesine.
Ma ꞌeguma ꞌaigeda hada ꞌoina waluhu, nugeta waloyauwedo ꞌoidiya.
Ceguma susuwedi ꞌidi mumuga ꞌausalana, wahelauwedi ma wagwae helauwedi, ma ꞌeguma ꞌidi mumuga galana sahena ꞌimi helau ma ꞌimi gwae helau ꞌoidiya wamudamudali.

“Ma ꞌeguma geya ꞌaigeda taiya ꞌitoegomi ꞌina hada, nuwana ꞌimi gwae geya ꞌihesagohedi, ꞌasaina ꞌoinega walatu ma ꞌahemiyega gawalina walohutuhutui yahuledi ꞌidi tupwa, beno ꞌebeꞌita ꞌasa taniwagadiyao ꞌoidiya, ma muliyetega ꞌasaina waꞌebesine.
Moisa, ꞌabwa yatala ꞌana tuta ꞌoina, taudi ꞌasaedi silologwahategemiya loina madou hedada siloba, ma geya gide meSodoma ma meGomola ꞌadi loina.
Muyamuya matada weyahina

“Wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega taugu yahesumanegomi gide sipi manamanasamumi watautauya ꞌedewa lolosasa gamwagamwanidiya, ꞌoinega sawasawahina ma wanuwasanapu mwata gide, ma hesi wamumuga hohonuha gide gabubu.
“Coinega waꞌitayahigomi, weyahina tomota ꞌabwa sitauyegomi, yatala weyahina, ma hada tapwalolo ꞌoidiya ꞌabwa siꞌetutuwegomi,
ma sitoegomi ma sitauyegomi toloinao ma kiniyao matadiya ma siheꞌewegomi, weyahina ꞌomi ꞌabehega ꞌigu bodao, ma wasagu ꞌoidiya wahepwaile, ma wete tupwa ꞌatamana tomotaedi ꞌimi hepwaila sihesagohe.
“Ma ꞌeguma matadiya sihetohologomi sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho togidega wagwae ꞌesa, weyahina tutaina ꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌimi gwae ꞌida ꞌebwaegomi,
ma geya ꞌabehega ꞌomi wagwaegwae, ma Yehoba yaluyaluwana ꞌoimiyega ꞌigwaegwae.

“Ma wete tuta sinaonaoma ꞌoidiya tomota ꞌidi susu ꞌalona loꞌaleha ꞌilatu weyahigu, beno loheya tasina ꞌitebae ma siloheꞌamasi. Gide wete tamana natuna ꞌitebae ma siloheꞌamasi. Wete gwagwama sinadiyao ma tamadiyao ꞌoidiya siloꞌaleha ma siloheꞌamasidi.

Ma tomota mabwaiyadi siloꞌalehegomi weyahina ꞌomi ꞌabehega ꞌagu tohemisao. Ma ꞌeguma taiyawedi siꞌalamaꞌiꞌita ma sitoholo paꞌala ma ꞌana siga tuta ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha ꞌoina, ꞌabwa yaliyaya hataya siloba.
“Ma ꞌeguma ꞌaigeda tupwa ꞌoina sihunuhunugomi, wadena hali ꞌasa ꞌoina. Moisa ꞌabwa, sahena ꞌasa mabwaiyana Isileli ꞌalona wapaipaihowa salohi, ma taugu loheyaiguina yahilama.
“Tomuliya geya sawasawahina ma ꞌina toheꞌita ꞌimadousine. Gide wete topaihowa geya sawasawahina ma ꞌina bada ꞌiloine.

Ma hesi ꞌausala ꞌeguma ꞌabehega ꞌomi ꞌagu tomuliyao, ma ꞌomi ma taugu tahemahemahetena. Weyahina taugu hada toniwagagu, ma ꞌeguma sihesaniyegau Tomudulele, ꞌomi ꞌigu bodao ꞌabwa siꞌahwa galagalaegomi madouna.
Matauta weyahina
“Coinega sahena tomotaedi wamatamatautedi, weyahina ginauledi ꞌwaiꞌwaihidi ꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌiꞌabi latuwedi, ma siꞌasilala.
Eeta toꞌaha guguyou ꞌoina yahepwailediya ꞌoimiya, sabwelowa wahepwailedi tomota baibaiwadi ꞌoidiya, ma toꞌaha yaheꞌahwa henahenaeya ꞌoimiya wahepwaila latuwedi ꞌimi talubeꞌuwega.

“Ma taudi wahimi siloloheꞌamasi sahena wamatamatautedi, weyahina taudi wahimimo sawasawahina ma siloheꞌamasi, ma yaluyaluwami geyaꞌabwa. Ma hesi Yehoba wamataute, weyahina tauna sawasawahina ma ꞌasa ꞌalaꞌalatana* ꞌoina wahimi ma yaluyaluwami ꞌiloheꞌamasi luwedi.
“Cebeꞌita bewa, ꞌeguma dinegwa ꞌeluwa tagimwanedi, ꞌadi maisa toea ꞌaigeda tuwa, ma hesi Yehoba ꞌiꞌitaꞌitayahidi, ma ꞌeguma ꞌaigeda ꞌiꞌamasa, beno Tamamiuina ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌoinega.
Ma bwagana geya sawasawahina ma hunuhunuwa wahasili deba ꞌaigeda ꞌoina, ma hesi Yehoba ꞌadi baibaiwa ꞌisanasanapu.
Coinega sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho, weyahina ꞌomi Yehoba ꞌina ginaula madouna, ma dinegwa geya ginaula madouna.
“Ceguma taiyawedi weyahigu sihehepwaila tomota matadiya, ꞌabwa galewa taugu wete weyahidi yahepwaila Tamagu matana.
Ma ꞌeguma taiyawedi siuhalegau tomota matadiya, taugu wete ꞌabwa galewa Tamagu matana yauhaledi.
Geya heꞌiyaꞌiyagu yatauyeyama ma hesi ꞌaleha
“Sahena wanuwanuwatuhu ꞌabehega ꞌigu dobima baleꞌuwa ꞌoinega nuwadaumwala waloba. Geya hene, ma ꞌaleha hesi.
Cigu dobima weyahina loheya tamana ꞌiloꞌalehe, ma wete wahine sinana ꞌiloꞌalehe, ma wahine lawana ꞌiloꞌalehe,
ma loheya ꞌina susu siloꞌalehe.

“Ma ꞌeguma taiya tamana ma sinana ꞌihelauwedi madouna, ma taugu ꞌiꞌiuna, tauna geya sawasawahina ma ꞌimuliyegau. Ma ꞌeguma taiya wete natuna meloheyana bo mewahinena, ꞌihelauwe madouna, ma taugu ꞌiꞌiuna, tauna geya sawasawahina ma ꞌimuliyegau.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya yawasina geya ꞌitagwale ma ꞌiꞌamasa kelose ꞌoina, gide taugu, tauna geya sawasawahina ma ꞌimuliyegau.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya tauna yawasina weyahina ꞌipaipaihowa, ꞌabwa ꞌiꞌwadalele; ma ꞌeguma taiya yawasina ꞌiꞌwadalele weyahigu, ꞌabwa yawasi ꞌausalana ꞌiloba hila.
Maisa weyahina
“Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌitoegomi, taugu ma ꞌagu Tohesumanaina wete ꞌitoemai.

Ma ꞌeguma ꞌowa palopita ꞌutoe ꞌina hepalopita weyahina, ꞌabwa palopita ꞌana maisa ꞌuloba. Ma ꞌeguma ꞌowa loheya ꞌausalana ꞌutoe ꞌina mumuga bwebweꞌana weyahina, ꞌabwa loheya bwebweꞌana ꞌana maisa ꞌuloba.
Ma ꞌeguma ꞌowa weꞌaha gogai ꞌagu tohemisa ꞌehauna ꞌaigeda ꞌoina ꞌuꞌehele, yahegwaego ꞌabwa ꞌa maisa ꞌausalana ꞌuloba.”
